description_en: Queries the profiling results of each catalog under a specified metadata profiling task by using paging and returns summary metrics such as the number of databases, tables, views, and partitions, storage capacity, and migration status for each catalog
description_zh: 分页查询指定元数据探查任务下各 Catalog 的探查结果，返回每个 Catalog 的库表、视图、分区、存储量与迁移状态等汇总指标
kebab_example: aliyun lhm list-meta-profiling-result-catalog-page --catalog-name catalog_hive_prod --db-name ods --group-by dbName --need-total-count true --order-by gmtCreate --order-direction DESC --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --task-id 100256 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMetaProfilingResultCatalogPage
